skill.name: context-degradation
skill.description: Explains how long context degrades AI agent performance and how to diagnose, prevent, and recover from common failure patterns.
skill.summary: Diagnose long-context failures and select mitigation strategies for AI agents.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Long context can make agents forget, confuse, or overuse information. This skill helps teams identify degradation patterns and choose mitigation strategies.
actual_capabilities: Explains lost-in-middle, poisoning, distraction, confusion, and clash patterns.
Lists symptoms that indicate context-related agent failure.
Recommends mitigation strategies such as filtering, compaction, task segmentation, and isolation.
Connects degradation patterns to benchmark and model-selection considerations.
Provides example structures for placing critical information in attention-favored positions.
limitations: It provides guidance only; it does not run tests or measure a live model.
Benchmark and model-specific values may become outdated and need verification.
It cannot prove the root cause without logs, prompts, and task outputs.
It does not replace privacy, safety, or production reliability review for AI systems.

use_cases.title: Debug Long Conversations
use_cases.description: Investigate why an agent loses facts, changes goals, or mixes old instructions after many turns.

use_cases.title: Design Retrieval Pipelines
use_cases.description: Choose filtering, priority rules, and version controls before adding documents to context.

use_cases.title: Plan Evaluation Coverage
use_cases.description: Create tests that expose lost-in-middle behavior, distractors, and clash across realistic context sizes.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Diagnosis
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when an agent performs worse after a long interaction.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this conversation or task log for context degradation. Identify likely patterns, cite symptoms, and suggest the next diagnostic step.

prompt_templates.title: Lost-in-Middle Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when important details may be buried inside a long context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Given this long document and target question, assess whether important evidence is buried in the middle. Recommend a better context layout.

prompt_templates.title: Mitigation Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when redesigning context flow for an agent workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: For this agent workflow, map each context source to a degradation risk. Propose filtering, compaction, masking, or isolation changes.

prompt_templates.title: Production Evaluation Design
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when building tests for long-context reliability.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an evaluation plan for a long-context agent. Include context length ranges, distractor tests, clash cases, success metrics, and remediation triggers.

output_examples.input: A support agent starts giving outdated policy answers after several retrieved documents are added.
output_examples.output: Likely pattern: context clash. Recommended next step: separate current and outdated sources, then apply priority rules before retrieval.

output_examples.input: An analysis agent ignores a key requirement placed halfway through a long prompt.
output_examples.output: Likely pattern: lost-in-middle. Recommended next step: move the requirement near the start or end and add a concise summary.

output_examples.input: A coding agent becomes slower and begins mixing details from unrelated tasks.
output_examples.output: Likely pattern: context confusion. Recommended next step: isolate tasks into separate sessions or sub-agents with focused context.

best_practices: Place critical goals, constraints, and conclusions near the beginning or end of context.
Filter retrieved material before it enters the active context window.
Use compaction and isolation before context length reaches known failure thresholds.
anti_patterns: Assuming a larger context window always improves answer quality.
Loading every related document without relevance checks or version rules.
Treating a model summary as verified truth after errors appear.

faq.question: What problem does this skill address?
faq.answer: It helps identify ways long context can reduce AI agent accuracy, consistency, and task focus.

faq.question: Does it execute any tools?
faq.answer: No. It is guidance in SKILL.md and does not define commands or scripts.

faq.question: Can it measure my model automatically?
faq.answer: No. It helps design diagnostic checks, but live measurement requires separate evaluation tooling.

faq.question: How does it help Claude, Codex, and Claude Code users?
faq.answer: It gives context design checks that apply to long-running coding, research, and agent workflows.

faq.question: When should I use it?
faq.answer: Use it when agent quality drops as prompts, retrieved documents, or conversation history grow.

faq.question: What inputs improve results?
faq.answer: Use conversation logs, prompt structure, retrieval sources, model settings, and examples of failed outputs.
